lines.en: Footsteps three blocks behind you.
I walk lightly. The grass stays still.

lines.zh: 我在你身后，隔着三块石板。
lines.en: I trail you by three flagstones.
I walk behind you without a sound.
Between shadows, I shift a step.
I am not quick. Never quick.
My steps borrow the sound of yours.

lines.zh: 你回头时，这里已经空了。
lines.en: Look back and the spot is empty.

lines.zh: 我在你家门外走了一圈。
lines.en: I walk a circle outside your door.
Soft soil, and I leave no print.
I circle your torch.

lines.zh: 你越走越快，我仍这个速度。
lines.en: You speed up. I keep my pace.
I stand where I am and watch.

lines.zh: 你转过身，这里什么都没有。
lines.en: Turn around. Nothing is here.
I stand at the treeline, still.
I was in this clearing first.

lines.zh: 你睡着后，我才靠近一步。
lines.en: Only after you sleep do I step closer.

lines.zh: 你盖房子的时候，我在看。
lines.en: I watched you build this house.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声，你总慢半拍听见。
lines.en: You always hear my footsteps half a beat late.
I fix on the lamp inside.
I have stood in that corner all along.
That feeling of being watched is me.

lines.zh: 我在窗棂上贴了整整一夜。
lines.en: I clung to your window frame all night.
I wait for you to sleep.
This wood is quiet the wrong way.
I follow you without a sound.

lines.zh: 你终于把眼睛抬起来了。
lines.en: You finally raised your eyes.
You were looking. I never left.

lines.zh: 你的脸，我已经描过很多遍。
lines.en: I have traced your face many times.

lines.zh: 你脸上有我很熟悉的东西。
lines.en: Something familiar is on your face.
I moved into this world first.

lines.zh: 你的房子，门朝错了方向。
lines.en: Your door faces the wrong way.
Do not douse the light. Dark brings me closer.
Listen. The steps are still there.
I have been at your window.
You should not have come alone.
I can say your name.
Do not run. It will not help.
I have stood here three days.

lines.zh: 你回头四次，我都躲开了。
lines.en: Four glances. I dodged all four.
The firelight stops short of me.
I stay until dawn.

lines.zh: 你看得太久了，眼睛会疼。
lines.en: Stare too long and your eyes will ache.
I am behind the tree behind you.
I heard every word you said.
Do not shout. No one is in these woods.

lines.zh: 刀锋过去，我只薄了一层。
lines.en: The blade passes; I am only a layer thinner.

lines.zh: 你打散的那团影，又合上了。
lines.en: The shadow you scattered closes again.

lines.zh: 你听见一声很近的呼气。
lines.en: You hear a breath very close.

lines.zh: 我被击中，形态晃了一下。
lines.en: Hit, my shape wavers.
Flesh is not part of me.

lines.zh: 你越用力，我越像你的影子。
lines.en: The harder you hit, the more I resemble you.
This body is only borrowed.
I recede into the shadow of trees.
You saw something. Then forgot.
Pain? The word means nothing to me.
Food? I have no use for it.

lines.zh: 你举着火把，我只看着火。
lines.en: You hold a torch. I watch the flame.

lines.zh: 你把门开着，是在等我吗？
lines.en: You left the door open. Waiting for me?
Do not try to drive me off with food.
What you hold will fall.
I do not eat. I only come closer.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，我不需要。
lines.en: I have no need for the torch in your hand.
Put it down and look at me.

lines.zh: 你的供品，摆在自己门口。
lines.en: Leave your offerings at your own door.
That smell does not interest me.
You bumped something cold.

lines.zh: 你的肩穿过我，像穿过冷气。
lines.en: Your shoulder passes through me like cold air.
You reach out and find nothing.
Do not come closer. You will see too much.
You did that to yourself.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你脚边断开了。
lines.en: My shadow breaks at your feet.
You back off. I remain.
A shoulder brushed past. You missed it.

lines.zh: 屋里的家具自己挪了位置。
lines.en: Your furniture moved on its own.
You closed the door yourself.
I have none of that.
We do not come about that way.

lines.zh: 我一个人，就够让你怕了。
lines.en: One of me is plenty.
You've looked back too many times.
This world needs only one of me.
Ask no more. I will not answer.
Breed? We simply appear.

lines.zh: 你身后那位，也许是同类。
lines.en: The one behind you may be kin.

lines.zh: 我怕的是被看清，不是孤独。
lines.en: I fear being seen, not solitude.
Be quiet and listen to the footsteps.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我放回原处。
lines.en: You dropped this. I put it back.

lines.zh: 地上的木头，我摆整齐了。
lines.en: I straightened the wood on the ground.
I lined your tools up in a row.

lines.zh: 门闩被人拉开了，你知道。
lines.en: The bolt was drawn. You know.
I lifted it into your chest.

lines.zh: 你的东西少了，不是我拿的。
lines.en: Something is missing. Not by me.
I shifted it half a block.
I blew out the torch on the floor.
I straightened your bed.

lines.zh: 收拾得太整齐，反而可怕。
lines.en: Tidier than you left it. That is the fear.
You saw me. Now it begins.

lines.zh: 你的气味在雪地上太清楚。
lines.en: Your scent is too clear on the snow.
Stop turning. I am right there.
The footsteps are closer.
Every shadow moves one way.
Your torch died for a moment.
The animals all ran the other way.
This time I do not hide.
You ran indoors. Perfect.
I follow. I have been following.
The lantern in your hand begins to shake.
Quieter. I can hear you.
The door creaks. Not by my hand.
I raise my head. The first time.
Now you cannot run.
I start walking. Slowly.

lines.zh: 每过一个拐角，我近一格。
lines.en: Each corner brings me a block closer.
Hear your own footsteps?

lines.zh: 我把你的火把一支支吹灭。
lines.en: I put out your torches one by one.
Count to ten and I am at the door.
No birds left in the wood.
I am on the other side of the house.
Keep the shutters shut. I still see.
Your shadow leans my way.

lines.zh: 我没有脚步声，只有你的。
lines.en: I have no steps. Only yours.
Your hand shakes on the door.
A little closer and I am at the wall.
I do not chase. I wait.
That wall behind you is thin.
Dawn is still far off.

lines.zh: 你听见屋顶上的声音了吗？
lines.en: Hear that on the roof?
I am counting your lamps.
You locked the door. Good.
No malice. Only watching.
Now turn around.
I stand an arm's length behind.
My hand settles on your shoulder.
A push. Very light.
Five fingers close. You cannot move.
The pain is cold, like ice.
I touched the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 你听见自己的骨头响了。
lines.en: You hear your own bones creak.
I barely pressed. You fell.
Do not turn. Not now.
What I seized was your shadow.
You will remember this one.
The air turns cold. Because of me.
I only wanted to touch something alive.
As you fall, I watch.

lines.zh: 手上没有温度，你察觉了。
lines.en: No warmth in my hands. You noticed.
I let go, and then you breathe.
Do not move. I am not done looking.
You heard the first footstep.
One more person in the woods.
The shape outside your window stops.
The world says: I was here first.

lines.zh: 你独处的时候，我就出现。
lines.en: You were alone. So I appeared.
Leaves rustle once, then still.
Your torch dims a little.
Someone already lived on this land.
I stand by the tree you just felled.
A door far off opens by itself.
The sky's color is a little wrong.
I am standing by your vegetable patch.
I have always been in this wood.
Not a monster. A gaze.
On the first night, I came.

lines.zh: 你听见背后有人在数呼吸。
lines.en: Something behind you counts breaths.
One more line of prints in the snow.
I do not knock when I arrive.
Look up. A shape overhead.
I am at the edge of your sight.
Fire shows me, and I step back.
Dropping from the canopy, not a blade of grass bends.
Water passes through us.
The blast lights up the whole wood.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去的洞里是空的。
lines.en: The arrow's hole is empty inside.
A spell scatters me briefly.
I need no food. Do not concern yourself.

lines.zh: 雷光里，我的轮廓清楚了。
lines.en: In lightning, my outline shows.

lines.zh: 虚空下面，有更多这样的我。
lines.en: Below the void, more like me.
